test_title: PYST 47 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: The word "oversaturation" means:

options.text: Too many graduates for available jobs

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Too many graduates for available jobs. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"oversaturation"** means: • A situation in which there are too many of a particular thing in relation to demand; in this context, it refers to having too many graduates for the available job opportunities. (एक स्थिति जिसमें मांग के अनुपात में किसी विशेष चीज़ की बहुत अधिकता हो; इस संदर्भ में, उपलब्ध नौकरी के अवसरों के लिए बहुत से स्नातक होना) • **Example:** The oversaturation of the job market has made it difficult for new graduates to find employment. • **"Correct answer"** means: • Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर) • **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured him a perfect score. Therefore, the word “oversaturation” in the given context means: **Too many graduates for available jobs**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Shortage of students** (छात्रों की कमी): A situation where there are not enough students enrolled or attending. • **Example:** The school is facing a shortage of students this academic year. • **Plenty of job opportunities** (नौकरी के अवसरों की प्रचुरता): Availability of many job openings for applicants. • **Example:** In the tech industry, there are plenty of job opportunities for skilled professionals. • **High salaries for all** (सभी के लिए उच्च वेतन): Everyone receiving large or substantial wages. • **Example:** The new policy ensures high salaries for all employees in the company. 48:Te5e, The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Improving skills to match new demands.
